# Legislacao Federal

## Overview

gSage AI — Brazilian federal legislation search and retrieval tool.

## Tool

| Tool | Summary | Permissions | Requires approval | Core |
| --- | --- | --- | :---: | :---: |
| `legislacao_federal` | Search and retrieve Brazilian federal legislation (laws, decrees, provisional measures, constitutional amendments). Find by type+number+year or keyword; get rich metadata (article structure, related legislation, DOU publication info); download full consolidated text as Markdown. | `gov:senado:legislacao:read` | — | — |
